evidence.why: Unconditional trailing helper clamps horizontal position.
Establishes Human as slot type zero.

facts.rationale: Replaces the unconditional shrink and implemented-input implications with exact canonical behavior, preserving the distinct timer boundaries and independent completion path.
facts.value: Entry selects BackCrush, assigns X and attribute-selected Y, clears all self velocity, saves the prior model scale, assigns an attribute-selected uniform scale, and initializes independent movement and scale counters. Enabled animation updates pre-decrement the scale counter, add the stored scale delta while the result is nonnegative, and otherwise clear the flag and restore the saved scale. Animation completion independently clears horizontal velocity and invokes waiting setup, without first requiring scale restoration. Physics pre-decrements its movement counter, conditionally adds attribute-parameterized horizontal movement while positive, otherwise clears horizontal velocity, and always applies floor-endpoint clamping. Human player slots invoke an empty boss-library hook; the collision callback is also empty.
